judge.rationale: The candidate delivers everything requested in the issue description, including making `createContext` optional when the router has no context so the issue's `localLink({ router })` snippet works out of the box. It places the link and tests in the exact same files as the reference (`packages/client/src/links/localLink.ts` and `packages/client/src/links.ts`) and uses the same core `callProcedure` and `observable` primitives. However, compared to the reference implementation, it constructs `TRPCClientError.from(error)` directly instead of formatting errors through `getTRPCErrorShape` (breaking custom router error formatters and `error.shape`/`error.data`), and it lacks support for async generator queries/mutations, subscription auto-reconnection with `lastEventId`, and default JSON serialization behavior. Additionally, the candidate diff includes extraneous modifications to `packages/server/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `jsonl.test.ts`, and `.lore/dod.md`.
